title: Transforming invasive weeds into energy solutions: water hyacinth-based hybrid electrodes for green supercapacitors
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,17302-17316
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02140E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shilpa Simon, Anila Rose Cherian, Sreeja P. B
Water hyacinth-based activated carbon, polypyrrole, and TiO2 form a hybrid electrode for supercapacitors. The WH–TiO2/PPy composite delivers 610 F g−1 capacitance, 94% retention over 5000 cycles offering a sustainable energy storage solution.
